display.purpose: Homepage hero headline; desktop clamp(3.5rem, 6vw, 6.6rem), mobile clamp(3.1rem, 12vw, 4.5rem).

title.purpose: Product cards and compact editorial titles.

body.purpose: Descriptions, prices, product information and forms; hero intro may clamp from 1rem to 1.125rem.

index.purpose: Small numbered indexes and approved brewing data.

motion.name: action-feedback
motion.purpose: Acknowledge button presses without moving unrelated icons.

motion.name: directional-panels
motion.purpose: Navigation and filters enter from the left, cart from the right, and search from below the shared header.

motion.name: editorial-image-hover
motion.purpose: Subtle response to image hover or keyboard focus.

motion.name: state-change-feedback
motion.purpose: Show FAQ, search-result, cart-line, and gallery state changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove spatial movement, image zoom, and list entrances while preserving essential interaction feedback.

motion.name: hero-cutout-hover
motion.purpose: Subtle response of the transparent loose-tea and tea-bag images on hover.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: A 48px forest-filled action with a square 2px corner and visible keyboard focus.
components.css: .button--dark { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--forest); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--forest); color: var(--paper); font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--font-body); } .button--dark:hover { background: var(--brand-hover); }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A clear outlined alternative with the same control height and corner geometry.
components.css: .button--outline { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--forest); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--forest); } .button--outline:hover { background: var(--parchment); }

components.name: Search Modal Field
components.description: One labelled input in a bounded 720px modal. Opening it does not change page flow.
components.html: <form role="search"><label class="sr-only" for="header-product-search">Search products</label><input id="header-product-search" name="q" type="search" placeholder="Search tea and tea bags" /></form>
components.css: .top { position: fixed; width: min(720px, calc(100vw - 32px)); max-height: min(640px, calc(100dvh - var(--shell-height) - 20px)); border: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--paper); }

components.name: Directional Modal Sheet
components.description: A modal enters from the same edge as its trigger: navigation and mobile filters from the left, cart from the right, and search below the header. It does not change document flow.
components.css: .sheet { transition: opacity var(--motion-panel) var(--ease-out), transform var(--motion-panel) var(--ease-out), display var(--motion-panel) allow-discrete, overlay var(--motion-panel) allow-discrete; }

components.name: Open Product Card
components.description: An open product image and copy presentation. Preview prices carry an explicit Sample price label.
components.css: .imageLink { display: block; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; overflow: hidden; background: var(--parchment); } article h3 { font: 400 clamp(1.25rem, 1.5vw, 1.55rem)/1.18 var(--font-editorial); }

narrative.overview: The supplied premium tea reference informs the dark forest stage, warm paper, restrained brass accents, high-contrast serif type, and product-led page rhythm. The Nilkurinji wordmark remains consistent. Only loose tea and tea bags appear as merchandise. The homepage presents a short tea selection before compact transparent cutout links for the two formats. Search remains modal and does not change header height. Preview sample prices and concept imagery are labelled, and purchases stay disabled.
keyCharacteristics: Preserve the Nilkurinji wordmark and sprout; omit the descriptor.
Show loose tea and tea bags as the only merchandise categories.
Show the featured tea selection before compact format links; cap desktop format frames at 320px.
Use the transparent tea and tea-bag photographs directly on the forest stage, without circles or oval masks.
Keep the shared shell compact and the product information factual.

rules.name: The Product Truth Rule
rules.body: Never use colour, copy, decoration, or imagery to imply unapproved origin, quality, health, delivery, ingredients, or product details.

rules.name: The One Logo Rule
rules.body: Use the same Nilkurinji wordmark and sprout dimensions on every route, without the removed descriptor.

rules.name: The Tea-Only Catalog Rule
rules.body: Only products assigned to the tea or tea-bags Shopify collection may appear in the unified Shop, search, product lookup, or recommendations. Tea format choices are filters within Shop.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Use rules, tonal surfaces, spacing, and photography to establish hierarchy. Avoid decorative shadows.

dos: Do keep the complete storefront merchandise range limited to tea and tea bags.
Do show featured tea products before compact tea-format links.
Do use the transparent loose-tea and tea-bag cutouts without circular backplates.
Do label preview amounts as Sample price and disclose concept imagery.
Do keep search and drawers modal, bounded, and keyboard reachable.
Do respect reduced-motion settings and visible focus.
donts: Do not add pantry foods, teaware, brewing equipment, storage products, or accessory bundles.
Do not add a currency chooser. Keep Shopify as the price and currency authority.
Do not invent sourcing, brewing, health, shipping, review, or quality claims.
Do not add Tea Guide, Recipes, Journal, or newsletter surfaces.
Do not use em dashes in shopper-facing copy.
Do not repeat foliage as section decoration or present preview assets as approved products.
